response.overview: Agus, a security guard at a low-cost apartment complex (rusun), is accused of being behind the disappearance of nine people after his testimony about mysterious lights is dismissed as nonsense. Pandji, a police officer, brands Agus a cannibal to close the case and protect the institution’s image. However, Darius, a detective, begins to doubt the accusation when a tenth missing person is reported. He reopens the investigation at the rusun despite stern warnings from his colleague, Prasetyo. His search leads him to Danang, another suspicious security guard, and a mysterious woman named Syifa and her daughter, Faza. Syifa, Agus’ wife, insists that her husband is innocent and that she herself witnessed the strange phenomenon. As Darius begins to realize that something has been covered up, he finally sees the truth that has long been ignored
response.title: Sidik Saksi Senandika
